title: Domain
description: A top-level canonical domain in the KUP learning graph. Fixed at 35 for Phase 1 -- see curriculum/graph.yaml. A domain is not a subject to complete; it exists because it gives KUP a representation no other domain gives it.

domainId.description: Stable, permanent kebab-case ID. Never renamed once referenced by a concept/bridge -- rename is a new ID plus a supersedes edge, not an in-place edit.

order.description: Position in the 35-domain inventory (not a prerequisite order -- see canonicalStackPosition for that).

kupRepresentation.description: Answers the governing question directly: what representation does this field give KUP that another field cannot? Required, non-generic -- 'this teaches math' is not a valid answer.

canonicalStackPosition.description: Where this domain sits in the MATHEMATICS -> ... -> WHOLE PHYSICAL SYSTEMS learning stack, if it has a fixed position. Null for domains that cut across the stack (e.g. Philosophy of Science, Logic).

relatedKupSystems.description: KUP repos/systems this domain's representations are known to feed (e.g. LogicHub, GlobeRAG, Orchade). Empty array is valid -- do not fabricate a relationship to look complete.

status.description: FROZEN = domain ID and definition locked, no concepts seeded yet. ACTIVE = has >=1 seeded concept. Phase 1 domains start FROZEN.
